rules.expected: Both named objects have object-specific configuration/connectivity validation and zero imaginary frequencies when accepted as minima. Establish E/Z correspondence from the mapped final geometry rather than filename or energy proximity.
The report declares a common protocol, temperature, environment and energy convention.

When status is complete, compare the reported numeric signed ΔG(E)−ΔG(Z) in kcal/mol to the source value 1.5 kcal/mol within 1.0 kcal/mol; when status is bounded_failure, accept a null difference only when the report identifies the failed validation and does not claim a favored object. Recompute the signed difference from the two identified same-protocol Gibbs energies and units. A bounded failure does not establish the energy difference or a preferred stereoisomer.

The validated 3aa_Z and 3aa_E free energies identify the preferred stereoisomer and the signed G(E)-G(Z) difference under the common thermochemical protocol. Restrict the conclusion to the computed E/Z thermodynamic comparison; it does not demonstrate experimental formation selectivity or a kinetic mechanism.
